editorial:
Imagine spending your whole life just doing favors for other people and never taking a risk. That is exactly where you find Brad, a guy who spends his days running errands and playing it safe. Everything changes when he starts hearing the voice of his dead Jewish grandmother in his head. She does not hold back, telling him that his boring life is a total embarrassment to the family name. It is a funny and weird setup that turns into a wild ride as Brad decides to finally shake things up, even if it means making some very bad choices to prove he is a man of action.

You will love how the tension builds as Brad steals a fancy Ferrari and tries to secretly buy a minor league baseball team. The acting is great, especially the way Brad looks more panicked as his lies pile up. While the middle part drags a little bit, the payoff is totally worth it. If you want to see this in the best quality, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for those crisp car chase scenes.
endingExplained: In the end, Brad's secret plan falls apart when his wife finds out about the stolen car and the baseball team. He realizes his grandmother's voice was actually his own guilt talking. He gives the Ferrari back and apologizes to his family. Instead of owning a team, he starts a small business of his own. He finally finds peace knowing he does not have to be a superstar to make his ancestors proud.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about mid-life crises and family chaos.
